earnings.title: FOR RELEASE AT 5:15 AM CT EXHIBIT 99.1
highlights: Adjusted free cash flow benefited from a $1 billion loan repayment from TCO and proceeds from asset sales.

The company’s Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of one dollar and seventy-eight cents ($1.78) per share, payable December 10, 2026, to all holders of common stock as shown on the transfer records of the corporation at the close of business on November 18, 2026.
Refined product sales decreased 9 percent from the year-ago period due to supply disruptions from the Middle East conflict.

quotes.text: We delivered strong operational performance and disciplined execution, while continuing to invest to grow energy supply.
quotes.by: Mike Wirth, Chevron’s chairman and chief executive officer
